notes: Drawing Colours (right-click a drawing): show one system in its own colour while the rest of the drawing is shown in grey, so the same service stands out on a tender drawing and on its construction drawing even when they use different colours. Show Only This Colour, Add This Colour and Remove This Colour work from the pipe under the mouse. Grey Out Area greys the parts of that system you don't want, and Show All Colours restores the drawing. The setting is kept with each drawing and Ctrl+Z undoes it. Takeoff, Pick Run and Claude still read the drawing as issued. Claude can set the same view with its new drawing_colours tool.
